pe5:73.11: yathābhūtaṃ viññāṇassa appavivedho ayaṃ avijjāsavo, avijjā viññābījaṃ bhavati.
pe5:73.12: yaṃ bījaṃ so hetu na samucchijjati. asamucchijjanto paṭisandahati,
pe5:73.14: asamugghātaṃ cittaṃ pariyonahati, pariyonaddhacitto yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. iti viññāṇassa sāsavattho avijjattho, hetuattho avicchedattho anivattiattho phalattho, paṭisandhiattho punabbhavattho, asamūgghātattho anusayattho, sampalibodhattho parīyuṭṭhānattho, asampaṭivedhattho avijjattho.
pe5:74.2: ugghaṭitamhi tamhi - santañceva naṃ vitthāraṃ pana vattabbaṃ
pe5:74.4: tattha nāmaniddeso upaghaṭako, vatthuniddeso vevacanaṃ vatthubhūto vitthāro.
pe5:74.5: yathā kiṃ: yo bhikkhu nivattato pahātabbo. ayaṃ upaghaṭanā.
pe5:75.2: kiñci na vattabbaṃ rūparāgaṃ vā nāmavantapahātabbaṃ.
pe5:75.4: avijjā tā opammena paññāpetabbā, ayaṃ samāropano
pe5:75.5: nissitacintassa va mattiko ca nissayo taṇhā ca diṭṭhi ca
pe5:75.7: tattha diṭṭhipaccayā taṇhā ime avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā.
pe5:75.8: tattha nissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ, idaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, yāva jarāmaraṇaṃ idaṃ saṅkhittena bhāsite avasiṭṭhaṃ paropayati [?]
pe5:76.1: “anissitassa calitaṃ natthi”ti tassa evaṃ diṭṭhiyā taṇhāya ca pahānaṃ, tattha diṭṭhi avijjānirodhāya yathābhūtaṃ viññāṇaṃ rāgaṭṭhāniyesu dhammesu taṃ taṃ dhammaṃ upecca aññaṃ dhammaṃ dhāvati makkaṭopamatāya: atha khvassa parittesu dhammesu rāgaṭṭhāniyesu chandarāgo natthi, kuto tato calanā, adhimattesu sattesu [?] cittaṃ nivesayati taṃ apaniṭṭhitaṃ viññāṇaṃ anāhāraṃ nirujjhati, viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodho, yāva jarāmaraṇanirodho
pe5:77.1: tattha rāgavasena viññāṇassa calitaṃ sapariggaho, tasmiṃ calite asati yo parikkilesopavāro tividho aggi paṭippassaddho bhavati.
pe5:77.3: tatthā’yaṃ samāropanā, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati,
pe5:77.5: so āsavānaṃ khayā ca vimuttino uppajjati.
pe5:77.6: tassa upapattissa āgatigatiyā asantiyā nevidha na huraṃ na ubhayamantarena,
pe5:77.8: idamassa suttassa majjhe samāropitaṃ paṭiccasamuppāde ca vimuttiyaṃ ca yogo, na ca etaṃ tassa saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhattanti
pe5:77.10: na ca saṅkilesabhāgiyena suttena suṅkilesabhāgiyo ye ca dhammā samāropayitabbā nāññe.
pe5:77.11: evaṃ vāsanābhāgiye nibbedhabhāgiye. ayaṃ samāropano hāro.
pe5:78.1: suvīrassa mahākaccāyanassa jambuvanavāsino peṭakopadese hāravibhaṅgo nāma pañcamabhūmi samattā
